description: Bring your AI into your Discord servers. Post updates, catch up on messages and route human replies to the right session. Start with whoami, then configure a default channel.
author: Serg Parf

post.help: Tell a Discord channel what your assistant did; without a channel, use Configuration default. Answers with channel and message ids.

read.help: Catch up on a channel, oldest first. Read 1 to 100 messages, default 50; omitted channel uses Configuration default.

channels.help: Find text channels in the configured servers, including configured aliases.

channel.help: See a channel’s id, name, type and topic.

react.help: Acknowledge a message with a Unicode or name:id emoji.

edit.help: Correct the text of a message sent by this bot. At most 2,000 characters.

delete.help: Remove a message. Discord requires manage-messages permission to delete someone else’s message.

thread.help: Start a named thread from a message; Discord allows one thread per message.

whoami.help: Check the bot’s identity and its configured servers without sending a Discord message.

sub.add.help: Forward each matching channel message to a bus queue or agent, subject to the author’s send rights to both destinations.

sub.list.help: See your subscriptions, including sent and dropped counts; direct Owners and Maintainers see all.

sub.delete.help: Stop your subscription; direct Owners and Maintainers may delete any. To edit, delete it and add it again.

channel.help: Configured alias, #name in an allowed server, or numeric channel id

text.help: Plain text; a post is split at 2,000 characters, at most eight parts

reply_to.help: Numeric message id to reply to

filter.help: A common subscription regular expression, or channel-name substring for channels

target.help: Bus queue or agent; the author must be allowed to send to it and this helper

guilds.help: Distinct server ids in which this bot may act; other guilds are refused

users.help: Discord user id to bus person; authorizes choosing sessions by tag

route.help: Default bus session for addressed messages

channels.help: Alias, #name or numeric id to {id, route?, tags?, anyone?}; numeric keys may omit id. Duplicate ids are refused.

default.help: Channel for a post or read with none supplied; omitted means refused
